results.title: Reco Raises $55M as Enterprises Confront AI Agent Security Risks | citybiz
results.content:
The financing brings Reco’s total funding to $140 million. The company plans to use the new capital to expand sales, partnerships, channel operations and customer support as large enterprises deploy more autonomous and AI-enabled agents across business applications and workflows.

AT&T is both an investor and a Reco customer, giving the financing a strategic component as enterprises grapple with how AI agents access corporate applications, data and identities. [...] The additional financing gives Reco more resources to build its commercial organization as agent security develops into a distinct area of enterprise cybersecurity. With AI systems gaining the ability to interact directly with corporate applications and execute business processes, the company is betting that understanding relationships among agents, identities, permissions and data will become a core requirement for enterprise security teams.
